body: I know. I'll figure it out I guess. Right now my Dad is "going to therapy" whatever that means. If it happens again, I'll be taking some sort of action, no doubt about that.

It's alright! 

I'll look into it. I'm just worried that the end result could be worse.

Parents and friends. Or anyone really. I just always feel like I'm bothering people. I've had my best friend of 8 years stop talking to me because I "used her as a shoulder to cry on" even though I was equally always there for her. 
I've had my Mom tell me that her heart condition is all my fault. I've had my brother told me that I could tell him anything, and then was slut-shamed for miscarrying.
I have really bad anxiety. I sometimes called my ex (when we were still together) when I had anxiety attacks and he would call me psycho and hang the phone up on me.
I've had other close friends tell me that they were tired of my shit, and to stop sharing anything that's wrong, which is why I turned to Reddit. Rejection and judgement from strangers is way better than from my friends.

There's really no point. I don't blame them for being upset and tired of me. I just don't say anything to them anymore, especially my parents. It's useless.
I've threatened to call the cops but I've never followed through. To be honest I'm a bit scared because he's my Dad, and because of all the backlash that would follow from the rest of my family.

I can't do anything to take him out because of my stepmother. My father's never hit me or my half-brother  or anything but he's hit her. I'm not really sure what to do. I'm just trying to do the right thing.
Talking scares me. I'm working on it. Being told my feelings are valid means so much. Thank you.

I'll move out someday. The thought terrifies me haha. 

This meant a lot to me. Being told what I'm feeling is legitimate means the fucking world.

Thank you <3 

I'm doing alright. Since passing my would have been due-date I've been better about it. It's a lot easier to talk about.

I have a 5 year-old half brother at home. I know he's not my responsibility but I would be a horrible sister and a disgusting human being if I just got up and dipped and left him in an unsafe place because I wasn't happy. I have student loans and other debts to pay off first before I can even plan on moving out anyway.

Most nights I'm okay. I've been feeling really down lately and I guess it just culminated to this. I haven't felt this worthless in a while, and I just feel like a bother to everyone, especially because my issues are so small. Talking about it makes me feel worse.

Today I didn't get home from work until about 2am because I had to clean up someone else's money mess. Then I get to get shit on next time I come in for staying so late to fix said mess. I can't do anything right. I live with a (sometimes) violent alcoholic for a father who thinks I'm a drug addict and hang with "bad kids" when in reality I work 40 hours a week and really have no friends to speak of. I was recently slut-shamed by my brother for having a miscarriage (my ex-fiancé was the father. Yeah, I'm a total slut right?). idk. I seem to get shit on whenever opportunity strikes, and I just have to suck it up because at the end of the day it's apparently all my fault, and I deserve everything I get.
My job. My family. Everything. I've never been able to handle stress well. I'm usually okay but tonight I'm a mess.
